items: The regional office has ____ conference rooms large enough for the annual training session.
'Conference rooms' is countable plural, so 'few' is correct.
There is ____ interest in extending the pilot program beyond the current quarter.
'Interest' is uncountable here, so 'little' is correct.
The recruiter invited ____ applicants back for a second interview.
'Applicants' is countable plural, and 'a few' expresses a small positive number.
We still have ____ time before the courier's pickup deadline.
'Time' is uncountable, and 'a little' expresses a small positive amount.
____ suppliers can meet the new packaging standard without modifying their equipment.
'Suppliers' is countable plural, so 'Few' is correct.
The revised contract gives the distributor ____ freedom to change retail prices.
'Freedom' is uncountable here, so 'little' is correct.
The technician replaced ____ worn cables before restarting the machine.
'Cables' is countable plural, and 'a few' expresses a small positive number.
Adding ____ insulation around the pipe should reduce heat loss.
'Insulation' is uncountable, and 'a little' expresses a small positive amount.
Very ____ complaints were received after the billing system was updated.
'Complaints' is countable plural, so 'few' is correct after 'Very'.
The committee showed ____ willingness to postpone the vote again.
Please reserve ____ tables near the entrance for guests with mobility needs.
'Tables' is countable plural, and 'a few' expresses a small positive number.
The analyst needs ____ more data before recommending a change to the forecast.
'Data' is treated as an uncountable mass noun in this business context, and 'a little' expresses a small positive amount.
Only ____ employees have requested printed copies of the new handbook.
'Employees' is countable plural, so 'few' is correct after 'Only'.
The current software provides ____ protection against that newly discovered security flaw.
'Protection' is uncountable here, so 'little' is correct.
The warehouse supervisor set aside ____ cartons for a manual quality check.
'Cartons' is countable plural, and 'a few' expresses a small positive number.
A short extension would give us ____ breathing room to finish the audit properly.
'Breathing room' is uncountable, and 'a little' expresses a small positive amount.
____ customers use the overnight drop box now that mobile deposit is available.
'Customers' is countable plural, so 'Few' is correct.
The startup has ____ cash available for nonessential purchases this month.
The event planner ordered ____ extra microphones in case one failed during the presentation.
'Microphones' is countable plural, and 'a few' expresses a small positive number.
The clerk added ____ postage to the envelope after weighing the documents again.
'Postage' is uncountable, and 'a little' expresses a small positive amount.
____ errors appeared in the final report because the figures had been checked twice.
'Errors' is countable plural, so 'Few' is correct.
The manager has ____ patience for repeated violations of the safety procedure.
The sales representative brought ____ product samples to the client meeting.
'Product samples' is countable plural, and 'a few' expresses a small positive number.
We have ____ flexibility in the schedule, so moving the workshop by an hour is possible.
'Flexibility' is uncountable, and 'a little' expresses a small positive amount.
The service center receives ____ requests for paper statements since most customers switched to online billing.
'Requests' is countable plural, so 'few' is correct.
